tiles.body: A worn cartridge inside the valve can't shut the water off completely. On most 1990s and 2000s valves, a new cartridge fixes it through the trim.
When the dishwasher or a toilet pulls water, a worn pressure-balancing cartridge lets the shower turn hot or cold.
Scale from well water clogs showerhead nozzles and the cartridge screen. Cleaning or replacing them usually restores flow.

tiles.h3: A Handle That Grinds or Sticks
tiles.body: Mineral buildup inside the valve. A new cartridge and some lubrication often fix it.

blocks.intro: Many Algonquin showers date to the 1990s and 2000s.

items.body: Valves from the 1990s and 2000s usually just need a new cartridge to work like new.
Minerals clog showerheads and stiffen cartridges. A softener helps.
Kids' bathrooms get heavy use and wear valves faster.
In two-story homes, a leaking shower valve or drain often shows up as a stain on the ceiling below. We find the source before opening anything.

blocks.h2: Shower Repair Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: Can a shower be fixed without opening the wall?
items.answer: Usually. Cartridge replacements go through the trim opening.

items.q: Why does my shower get hot when the dishwasher runs?
items.preview: The pressure-balancing part of the valve is worn.
items.answer: When another fixture pulls cold water, the valve should balance it. If it doesn't, the balancing cartridge is likely worn.

items.q: How do I fix a weak showerhead?
items.preview: Soak it in vinegar or replace it.
items.answer: Scale from well water often clogs the nozzles. Soak it in vinegar or replace it. If that doesn't help, the cartridge may be scaled too.

items.q: Can you replace my shower valve trim to match a remodel?
items.preview: Often, if it's the same brand.
items.answer: Often, if the new trim is from the same brand and line as the valve. Otherwise, the valve may need replacing.

items.q: Can you replace a tub spout or diverter?
items.answer: Yes. A diverter that won't send water up to the showerhead, or a spout that drips while the shower runs, is a common, quick fix.

items.q: What does shower repair cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the valve and parts. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on the valve, the parts and access. We quote a flat rate before we start.
